articles.title: Enhypen star in ‘scary stories’ podcast from Hybe and Spotify
articles.description: Who knew the members of K-Pop band Enhypen were vampires? At least that explains the lack of mirrors in their stage sets, their refusal to play daytime slots at festivals, and the strict ‘no garlic’ clause in their tour rider. Oh wait, they’re only pretending…
